subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should final-path symlinked `IDENTITY.md` files remain supported for structured identity metadata, or should all workspace identity readers require regular files?
rationale: The dependency-backed helper concretely changes a currently accepted workspace path into a rejected one; choosing compatibility or a stricter trust boundary requires maintainer intent rather than an implementation-only judgment.

options.title: Preserve bounded symlinks
options.body: Continue following final symlinks within the workspace boundary while enforcing the shared 2 MiB limit.

options.title: Require regular files
options.body: Reject final symlinks consistently across bootstrap and metadata readers as an intentional hardening and upgrade change.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded symlinks
recommendation.body: Continue following final symlinks within the workspace boundary while enforcing the shared 2 MiB limit.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current boundary-safe workspace reader and size contract most directly affected by this decision.
